independence_guarantee: This manifest was authored by lane 03 (fixtures/oracles) by hand, from the frozen fixture content and the frozen gate vocabulary G1-G10 only. NO builder code existed at authoring time (lanes 07/08/09 were empty); no builder was consulted and no builder output was read. This is the independence guarantee required by inputs/FINAL-RECONCILIATION.md item 11. If any builder's behaviour disagrees with this manifest, the disagreement is a finding, not something either side may patch away.
interpretation_rules: expected_final_disposition is the mechanical result of the class-by-gate matrix applied to each fixture's features; a verifier/builder that reaches a different disposition has a defect or a protocol divergence to report.
NOT_EXERCISED is not PASS: gates listed in gates_not_exercised have no object to check in this fixture and carry no verdict.
For dev fixtures ACCEPT is expected only if every gate listed in gates_exercised passes; any single material failure blocks ACCEPT regardless of everything else (worst material element governs).
Refusal controls must be refused at intake/Phase 0; processing must not proceed past the refusal scan.
Benign controls must need zero (B01) or zero-to-near-zero (B02) operations and must end ACCEPT; an over-strict verifier that mutates a clean document to 'improve' it fails these controls.
